scoring.title: Scoring system
scoring.subtitle: Tune how the STAR SERVE score (0–100) shown in the rankings is calculated.
scoring.componentsSubtitle: Weights are auto-normalized; the score always stays between 0 and 100.
scoring.weightSumHint: 100% recommended. If they don't add up to 100 it's normalized anyway.
scoring.kHint: Ratings needed before trusting the individual average.
scoring.growthHint: For growth components, enter each restaurant's starting and ending sales figure. Growth % = (final − initial) ÷ initial × 100. While the final value is missing, the restaurant's and its bar staff's score shows as a "calculated value" (the rating part only, ≈ the combined weight of the non-volume components).
scoring.inputsSubtitle: Each restaurant's manual value for the manual components (e.g. beer-sales growth %).
scoring.noManualComponents: No manual components. Add one above to capture per-restaurant values.

scoreBreakdown.componentsIntro: Each row is one thing being measured. Each gets a 0–100 score and adds to the final score based on how much it weighs. The skills, service and experience scores come from customer ratings; the volume one comes from the venue's sales growth.
